title: One Who Lives In Meditative Remembrance, Even
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 239
summary: Seeking is carried here from one who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant, toward says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels searching, hungry, unsettled, because it keeps seeking inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Seeking steadies when says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world.

lines.translation: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's life is like that of a snake.
This is how the faithless cynic lives, forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek nimakh jo simaran meh jeeaa ||
lines.translation: One who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: koT dhinas laakh sadhaa thir theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: lives for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever. ||1||Pause||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's actions and works are cursed.
Like the crow's beak, he dwells in manure. ||2||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one acts like a dog.
The faithless cynic is nameless, like the prostitute's son. ||3||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.
The faithless cynic barks out his lies, and his face is blackened. ||4||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a donkey.
The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ||5||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a mad dog.
The greedy, faithless cynic falls into entanglements. ||6||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he murders his own soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: saakat neech tis kul nahee jaatee ||7||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bhiaa kirapaal tis satasa(n)g milaiaa ||
lines.translation: When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ||8||7||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: one who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world.
